title: UNVERIFIED — The Church That Is Now an Arboretum

features.name: a window sharded with bark
features.desc-on-touch: Wrapped in vines. The fallen stones are structured, now, as an arboretum.

features.name: the pulpit, leaf crumble in it
wind and bird holler
features.desc-on-touch: Bach used to write organ fugues in accordance with the geometry of the church they would be played in. So too this church.

features.name: the end of the trail
features.desc-on-touch: The ruins do their part to commemorate an emphatic desire for symbols.

inscription: we turn the internal geography of our twin subjectivities towards the landscape that surrounds us

file.name: Church_Ruins_Fugue.wav
file.note: Field recording. The building is the instrument. Nobody is playing it.
